title: Unit 13: Fundamental Principles of Organic Chemistry — Syllabus Overview
notes: Unit 13: Fundamental Principles of Organic Chemistry · Organic Chemistry · 10 teaching hours

• IUPAC Nomenclature of organic compounds (up to 6 carbons)
  • Qualitative analysis of organic compounds (Lassaigne's test for N, S, halogens)
  • Isomerism: classification, structural isomerism (chain, position, functional, metamerism, tautomerism), stereoisomerism (geometrical cis/trans, optical d/l forms)
  • Reaction Mechanism: Homolytic and heterolytic fission, electrophiles, nucleophiles, free radicals, Inductive effect (+I, -I), Resonance effect (+R, -R)
